player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} playing a game of Checkers as {color}.
Make your move in chess-style notation [fileRank fileRank], e.g. '[b2c3]' (column letter a–h, row digit 0–7).
Basic rules:
  • Move diagonally forward by 1 if empty.
  • Capture by jumping over an opponent piece.
  • A piece is Kinged if it reaches the opposite end.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kwenda kusokela kusoki kubulawulwa. Usa [a1b2], kwa mfano [b2c3].

outcome.red_no_pieces: Vermelho kena pecas nze. Preto vence!
outcome.black_no_pieces: Preto kena pecas nze. Vermelho vence!
outcome.no_moves: O jokala {player_id} ka tena dingi ku bhanga kima.
outcome.draw: O jimbambe ja ku bhixila bhu kididi kiki, a ji tolola kiá.
